citation.authors: Kirkbride JB, Errazuriz A, Croudace TJ et al

cited_by.title: Psychosis, sectioning and misdiagnosis in the UK

record.population: 83 citations, people aged 16 to 64 with first-onset psychosis, England 1950 to 2009
record.design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of incidence
record.finding: Rates of psychosis were higher in several ethnic minority groups than in white British people. For schizophrenia the pooled rate ratio was 5.6 for Black Caribbean people (95% CI 3.4 to 9.2) and 4.7 for Black African people (3.3 to 6.8). The studies were mostly cross-sectional, which limits conclusions about cause.
record.note: Abstract read. Incidence studies were mostly cross-sectional, with high heterogeneity; the review cannot say why rates differ.
